turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance to my booking, but when I check online, it’s not showing up. I’m flying with my family and everyone else has insurance, so I really need to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I understand your concern about travel insurance for your upcoming flight. To assist you, I’ll need your user ID and your reservation ID. If you don’t know your reservation ID, I can help you locate it once you provide your user ID.

Could you please provide your user ID and, if possible, your reservation ID?
Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and my reservation number is PEP4E0. Can you please check why the insurance isn’t showing up for me? I really want to make sure I have it before we travel.

I’ve checked your reservation (PEP4E0) and, unfortunately, travel insurance was not added to your booking. According to our policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of the initial booking and cannot be added afterward.

I understand this may be disappointing, but I’m unable to add insurance to your reservation at this stage. If you have any other questions or need assistance with your booking, please let me know.

That’s really frustrating, especially since everyone else in my family has insurance for this trip. I was sure I added it when I booked, and I really need to have the same coverage as them. Is there absolutely nothing you can do to help me get insurance added to my flight? I don’t want to travel without it.

I understand how important it is to have travel insurance, especially when traveling with your family. However, according to our policy, I am unable to add insurance to your reservation after the initial booking is completed. This restriction applies to all reservations, and even a human agent would not be able to override this policy.

If you have any other questions or need help with your reservation, please let me know. If you would like to discuss this further with a human agent, I can transfer you, but please note that the policy cannot be changed. Would you like to be transferred to a human agent for further assistance?

No, I really don’t want to be transferred. I just want to have the same insurance as my family for peace of mind. Isn’t there any exception or workaround you can offer? Maybe there’s another way to get coverage linked to my booking? I’d really appreciate any help you can give me.

I understand your concern and your desire to have the same insurance coverage as your family. However, I must follow the airline’s policy, which strictly prohibits adding travel insurance to a reservation after the initial booking. There are no exceptions or workarounds available within the system, and I am unable to link any external or new insurance to your existing booking.

If you have any other questions about your reservation or need assistance with something else, I am here to help.

That’s really disappointing. I just want to make sure I’m protected like everyone else in my group. Is there any way you can at least recommend what I should do next, since I can’t add insurance through you? I want to make sure I’m covered for this trip.

I’m sorry, but I am unable to provide recommendations or advice outside of the airline’s policies and procedures. If you have any other questions related to your reservation or need assistance with booking, modifying, or canceling flights, I am here to help.
Alright, I understand. Thanks for checking for me anyway. That’s all I needed for now.
You’re welcome. If you need any assistance with your reservation in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a safe and pleasant trip!
Thank you. Have a good day. ###STOP###
